measure.caption: Licensure of Large Retailers to Finance a Clean Energy Fund
measure.question: Shall voters adopt ordinance imposing on large retailers a licensing requirement and 2% fee to finance a clean energy fund?

summary.text: If approved, the measure would require large retailers to obtain a license and pay an annual 2% license fee on gross profits.
summary.quote: require large retailers to obtain a license and pay an annual 2% license fee on gross profits from retail sales within the City.

summary.text: Large retailers are defined as those with national gross profits exceeding $1,000,000,000 and Eugene gross profits exceeding $500,000, excluding certain entities.
summary.quote: defines "large retailer" as one engaged in retail sales in Eugene with gross profits exceeding $1,000,000,000 nationally and $500,000 in Eugene, excluding contractors, utilities, cooperatives, and credit unions.

summary.text: If approved, the measure would exclude most groceries, medicines, and certain services from the 2% fee calculation.
summary.quote: Gross profits from retail sales upon which the 2% is calculated would not include sales of most groceries, medicines, residential garbage and recycling services, and health care services.

summary.text: If approved, the measure would place license fee proceeds in a fund for renewable energy, efficiency, programs, and administration.
summary.quote: require proceeds from the license fee to be placed in a "Eugene Clean Energy Fund" dedicated to funding renewable energy and energy efficiency programs; clean energy job training, apprenticeships, and contractor support; green infrastructure programs; future innovation; and fund administration
